nodes.id: document:docs/NOTION-DOCS/Pi to Pi Two-Way Agent Orchestration with the Pi C 64fe03c77410491787f2007caf708f1a.md
nodes.name: Pi to Pi Two-Way Agent Orchestration with the Pi C 64fe03c77410491787f2007caf708f1a.md
nodes.filePath: docs/NOTION-DOCS/Pi to Pi Two-Way Agent Orchestration with the Pi C 64fe03c77410491787f2007caf708f1a.md
nodes.summary: Captures a transcript-grounded runbook for Pi-to-Pi peer mesh orchestration, including install steps, protocol expectations, guardrails, and complementary infrastructure picks. It translates external video research into a harness-oriented architecture guide.

nodes.name: GOAL.md
nodes.summary: Defines the parent wrapper fitness function, stopping conditions, bootstrap sequence, and bounded improvement loop for the portable parent wrapper. It is the governing goal contract for evidence-backed self-improvement of the harness root.

nodes.name: library.yaml
nodes.summary: Registry configuration for the parent wrapper catalog, organizing prompts, capabilities, references, and jobs into a portable library spine. It binds key documentation and operational scripts to named catalog entries.
nodes.languageNotes: The YAML is structured as grouped catalog records for prompts, capabilities, references, and jobs rather than runtime settings alone.

nodes.name: program.md
nodes.summary: Specifies the local execution protocol for parent-wrapper ratchet runs, including setup, mutable surface boundaries, validation loop, report contract, and hard rules. It operationalizes how the parent wrapper should run and prove bounded improvement cycles.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level overview of the FRE Meta Harness parent wrapper, enumerating its scaffold, contract surfaces, proof package, tool-health doctrine, and current role. It is the main orientation document for the standalone parent repository root.

nodes.name: score-parent-wrapper.py
nodes.summary: Computes the parent-wrapper process score by combining outcome and instrument metrics from iteration logs, validation artifacts, tool-health evidence, and contract coverage. It is the scoring CLI that writes evaluation/metrics-latest.json for the parent improvement loop.
nodes.languageNotes: The script uses pathlib-rooted repository traversal with jsonschema and YAML validation to score filesystem evidence rather than in-memory application state.

nodes.name: validate_parent_wrapper_contract.py
nodes.summary: Runs the parent-wrapper contract validation suite across scaffold markdown contracts, schemas, examples, tool-health truth boundaries, orchestration contracts, iteration logs, and promotion readiness. It writes validation and readiness artifacts that gate parent-wrapper progress.
nodes.languageNotes: The validator mixes markdown front-matter parsing with jsonschema and YAML checks, then emits report and readiness artifacts directly from repository state.

nodes.name: load_iterations
nodes.summary: Loads runs/iterations.jsonl and filters rows through the iteration-record schema while collecting parse and validation errors.

nodes.name: is_substantive_path
nodes.summary: Classifies whether a changed file counts as substantive improvement evidence instead of documentation-only or bookkeeping output.

nodes.name: parent_native_surface_refresh
nodes.summary: Validates parent-native orchestration contracts and example artifacts, then computes the contract-coverage portion of the parent-native surface score.

nodes.name: consecutive_non_improving_cycles
nodes.summary: Counts trailing rejected or reverted iterations to detect a real plateau in recent score history.

nodes.name: artifact_span_seconds
nodes.summary: Measures timestamp spread across required artifact files to estimate whether the evidence set was refreshed together.

nodes.name: report_completeness
nodes.summary: Scores copilot-ratchet report completeness by checking schema validity, required fields, per-cycle history detail, and ledger alignment.

nodes.name: metric_decision_truth
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the report's metric decision and review fields support an honest accepted or repaired outcome.

nodes.name: ratchet_execution
nodes.summary: Scores whether real non-dry ratchet cycles exist, validate cleanly, and include kept substantive changes with aligned reporting.

nodes.name: non_dry_cycle_depth
nodes.summary: Measures depth of the improvement loop by counting substantive kept cycles and rejected challenge cycles in the real ledger.

nodes.name: plateau_or_blocker_truth
nodes.summary: Checks whether continuing, plateau, or blocker status claims are consistent with cycle history and stop evidence.

nodes.name: artifact_refresh
nodes.summary: Scores artifact completeness and freshness together with tool-health evidence and parent-native contract coverage.

nodes.name: build_score
nodes.summary: Aggregates outcome and instrument component scores into the final parent-wrapper metrics payload and weakest-component summary.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint that builds the score, writes metrics-latest.json, and optionally prints the JSON payload.

nodes.name: parse_markdown_contract
nodes.summary: Parses scaffold markdown files into front matter and bottom matter sections so each contract surface can be schema-validated.

nodes.name: load_jsonl
nodes.summary: Loads JSONL rows from a file while preserving per-line parse errors for later reporting.

nodes.name: validate_examples
nodes.summary: Validates the repository's positive examples and expected-failure fixtures against the relevant schemas.

nodes.name: validate_capability_metrics_contract
nodes.summary: Checks that the parent capability metrics contract matches its schema and expected metric-family IDs.

nodes.name: validate_tool_health_truth
nodes.summary: Enforces honest bounded-status rules and evidence requirements for GitNexus, Graphify, and InfraNodus tool-health reporting.

nodes.name: validate_parent_native_contracts
nodes.summary: Cross-validates the parent-native peer mesh, message, lifecycle, observability, policy, runtime, hook, role, and capability contracts for internal consistency and evidence coverage.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the full validation suite, assembles check results, writes validation and readiness artifacts, and returns the overall pass or fail status.
